brief:
The General Petroleum and Gas Authority in Gaza confirmed Wednesday evening that five trucks of cooking gas entered the territory for distribution to residents, Shehab Wire reported. The shipment arrives as the enclave faces persistent fuel shortages affecting households across the sector.

Gaza has struggled with chronic energy deficits in recent years, with cooking gas supplies among the most critical commodities for civilian populations. The authority did not specify the timeline for distribution to residents or the total volume of gas contained in the five trucks delivered Wednesday.
